channels.label: ROC_LOC
channels.reason: Bipolar ROC-LOC eye derivation; the single bipolar EOG target takes this one.

channels.label: LOC_ROC
channels.reason: Inverted duplicate of ROC-LOC; the EOG target is already assigned.

channels.label: F2_F4
channels.reason: Bipolar frontal chain with no mastoid reference, so it has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: F4_C4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_P4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: P4_O2
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain, not O2 against a mastoid, so it has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: F1_F3
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: F3_C3
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C3_P3
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain with no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: P3_O1
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain, not O1 against a mastoid, so it has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_A1
channels.reason: C4 referenced to the contralateral left ear (A1) is equivalent to C4-M1; the neuro trace fits.

channels.label: EMG1_EMG2
channels.reason: Bipolar EMG with 10-100 Hz filtering and an EMG-like trace; taken as chin EMG.

channels.label: ECG1_ECG2
channels.reason: Bipolar ECG lead and the trace looks like ECG.

channels.label: TERMISTORE
channels.reason: Italian 'termistore' means thermistor airflow, and the trace is respiratory.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: Italian 'torace' means thoracic effort belt, and the trace is respiratory.

channels.label: ADDOME
channels.reason: Italian 'addome' means abdominal effort belt, and the trace is respiratory.

channels.label: Dx1_DX2
channels.reason: 'Dx' means right; an EMG pair with an EMG trace, taken as right tibialis.

channels.label: SX1_SX2
channels.reason: 'Sx' means left; an EMG pair with an EMG trace, taken as left tibialis.

channels.label: Posizione
channels.reason: Italian 'posizione' means body position; the flat DC trace fits a patient who stayed in one position.

channels.label: HR
channels.reason: Oximeter heart rate in BPM, and the trace looks like HR.

channels.label: SpO2
channels.reason: Oximeter saturation in %, and the trace looks like SpO2.
